I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team. I couldn't check the 8 April renewal date: nothing Pree has access to mentions Brackenwater Freight Co. That includes the account folders in the share, #central-team's history and the two Central digests.

I told Pree I've noted it as unconfirmed but not recorded it anywhere as the renewal date. It should stay unconfirmed until the account owner checks it against the contract or gets it from the customer in writing. I didn't search other channels or restricted files, because Pree can't see those.
